name: shimmer-trace
title: Shimmer Trace
description: Skeleton loading that traces your real markup: wrap content in Shimmer and it measures the rendered elements and paints one synchronized shimmer over them. Five animations, list cloning, Suspense.
author: Jeet Vora <https://github.com/jeetvora331>
docs:
Installed `Shimmer`, `createShimmer`, `ShimmerSuspense` and `useIsShimmering` (`@/components/ui/shimmer-trace`), with the tracer and types in `@/components/ui/shimmer-trace-core`. No dependencies.

```tsx
import { Shimmer } from "@/components/ui/shimmer-trace";

<Shimmer loading={isLoading} dummyData={{ user: placeholderUser }}>
  <ProfileCard user={user} />
</Shimmer>
```

Wrap the content you would render when loaded: while `loading` it is rendered hidden, measured, and covered by one synchronized shimmer. Give it `dummyData` (or `as` plus `dummyLength` for lists) so it has a realistic shape before data arrives. Theme it with `baseColor` and `highlightColor`. The skeleton is measured in the browser, so server-rendered HTML shows the hidden content until it hydrates.

Ported from shimmer-trace by Jeet Vora (MIT); the license notice is at the end of every file.
